_readme: Model registry for the calculator and (Phase 2) programmatic pricing pages. Prices are USD per million tokens, standard API tier, cache-miss. Verify against source_url and bump `updated` when editing. slug must be URL-safe and stable.

models.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
models.note: Flagship tier of the GPT-5.6 family, GA since 2026-07-09. Promotional price (cut from $5 / $30 in late July), guaranteed at least through 2026-11-21.

models.name: GPT-5.6 Luna
models.note: Cut 80% from $1 / $6 on 2026-07-30; now matches GPT-5.4 nano on input.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.note: Shipped 2026-09-01 at Fable 5 prices, but cache reads drop to $0.25 (0.025x input) versus $1 on Fable 5.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5
models.note: Launched as introductory pricing through 2026-08-31; Anthropic made $2 / $10 the permanent price instead of raising to $3 / $15.

models.name: Gemini 3.7 Flash
models.note: Introductory price through 2026-12-31; rises to $1.50 / $7.50 on 2027-01-01.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
models.note: Peak-hour price (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Mon-Fri) since 2026-08-16; off-peak is half: $0.66 / $1.98. Cache-hit input $0.044.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
models.note: Peak-hour price since 2026-08-16; off-peak is half: $0.22 / $0.66. Cache-hit input $0.014.

models.name: Kimi K3
models.note: 2.8T open-weight MoE; always reasons, so reasoning traces bill at the output rate. Cache-hit input is $0.30.

models.name: Grok 4.5
models.note: xAI's V9-Medium coding model (1.5T), shipped 2026-07-08; superseded by Grok 4.6 on 2026-08-12 at the same price.

models.name: Grok 4.6
models.note: xAI's flagship since 2026-08-12; 500K context. A faster variant bills at double these rates.
